protocol: Manual inspection of source photos and overlays for the frozen production prompt. T means the entire description is supported in pixels, B means the rectangle reasonably encloses the described detail, P means a physical target-product feature, D marks an additional repeat of a previously reported semantic feature. These are subjective development judgments, not dataset accuracy estimates.
